title: Secret Birthday Wish
tooltip: Someone sent you a birthday surprise 🎂
messages: Hey!! 🎉
Someone special asked me to deliver this...
They said you deserve the most magical birthday ever.
So take a deep breath and smile 😊
Happy Birthday, superstar 🎂🎉

title: Someone Loves You
messages: Hey 👀
Someone around you asked me to tell you something...
They have been thinking about you — a lot.
Every single day.
And yes... they love you ❤️

title: You Are My Everything
messages: Close your eyes for a second...
Someone wants you to know something...
You light up every room you walk into.
And every moment without you feels incomplete.
You are their everything 🌹

title: Someone Noticed You
messages: Okay so...
Someone in your circle noticed you today 👀
They said your smile is dangerous.
Dangerously beautiful.
They dare you to guess who 😏

title: Be My Valentine
messages: February 14th is special...
But this message is for you every day.
Someone wants to hold your hand.
Walk beside you.
Will you be their Valentine? 💝

title: Your Secret Admirer
tooltip: A secret admirer has a message
messages: Shh... this is between us 🤫
Someone admires you from a distance.
They notice the little things about you.
Your laugh. Your kindness. Your energy.
One day they'll tell you in person... 👀

title: You Did It!
messages: WAIT.
Did you really just do that?! 🎊
Someone is SO proud of you right now.
They said you worked hard and you deserve this.
Congratulations, champion! 🏆

title: Graduate of the Year
messages: Cap. Gown. Certificate. 🎓
Someone wants to celebrate YOU.
Years of hard work, late nights, and sacrifice.
You made it through it ALL.
Congratulations, Graduate! The world is yours 🌍

title: Still Crazy About You
messages: Another year...
Another 365 days of choosing each other ❤️
Someone wants you to know...
They would do it all over again.
Happy Anniversary, love 💍

title: I'm Sorry
tooltip: An apology is waiting for you
messages: Hey...
This is hard to say but it needs to be said.
Someone hurt you. And they know it.
They're sorry. Truly.
They hope you can forgive them 🙏

title: You Are Appreciated
messages: Hey you!
Yes, YOU.
Someone wants you to know you're not invisible.
You matter more than you think.
Thank you for being you 💛

title: Let's Start Over
messages: It's been a while...
Someone misses you.
They've been thinking about what went wrong.
And they want to make it right.
Can we start over? 🕊️

title: Keep Going
messages: Hey, I know it's been tough.
Someone sees you fighting every day.
They want you to know — don't give up.
The breakthrough is closer than you think.
Keep going. You've got this 💪

title: You Are Not Alone
tooltip: A message of comfort and love
messages: Words feel small right now...
But someone wants you to know they're here.
You don't have to carry this alone.
Grief is love with nowhere to go.
They are holding you in their heart 🤍

title: You've Been Exposed 😂
messages: ATTENTION ⚠️
We have received reports...
That you are TOO FINE for your own good.
This is a formal warning.
Please reduce your attractiveness immediately 😂

title: Your Phone Has a Virus 😈
messages: ALERT 🚨
Your phone has detected 47 viruses.
Just kidding 😂
But someone DID detect something...
That you're absolutely hilarious. They love you 😂

title: You're Dangerously Attractive
messages: Okay let's be real...
Someone cannot stop thinking about you.
Not in a creepy way.
In a 'you walked in and stole the whole vibe' kind of way 🔥
You know exactly what you're doing 😏

title: The Forbidden Crush
messages: This message is rated PG-13 🙈
Someone has been very distracted lately...
Because of YOU.
They tried to stop thinking about you.
They failed completely 😅❤️

title: Santa's Secret Message
tooltip: A Christmas surprise is hidden here 🎄
messages: Ho ho ho! 🎅
Santa received a very special request this year...
Someone asked for only one thing.
For YOU to have the most magical Christmas ever.
Merry Christmas! 🎄⭐

title: New Year, New Feelings
tooltip: A New Year message with a secret
messages: As the clock strikes midnight...
Someone is thinking of you.
Of all the people they want beside them as the new year begins.
They chose you.
Happy New Year! May this year be yours 🥂✨

title: Eid Blessing From Someone Special
messages: Eid Mubarak 🌙
Someone wanted to celebrate this day with you.
They pray for your happiness, health, and peace.
May Allah bless you and your family.
Taqabbal Allahu minna wa minkum 🤲

title: Sallah Wishes From the Heart
messages: Eid al-Kabir Mubarak! 🐑
Someone is grateful to share this blessed day with you.
They pray your sacrifice is accepted.
May this season bring you joy and abundance.
From their heart to yours ❤️🌙

title: A Patriotic Secret
messages: Happy Independence Day! 🎊
Someone is thinking about you on this special day.
They are proud to share this nation with people like you.
Keep being the change you want to see.
Nigeria/[Country] is better because of you 🇳🇬

title: Easter Surprise
tooltip: An Easter message is hidden here 🐣
messages: He is risen! 🌅
And with this new season comes a new message...
Someone wants to fill your Easter with joy.
May this season bring renewal, hope, and love.
Happy Easter! 🐣🌸

title: Congratulations Newlyweds
tooltip: A wedding day message of love
messages: Today is THE day 💍
Two hearts. One forever.
Someone wants to celebrate this beautiful union.
May your love story be legendary.
Congratulations on your wedding! 🥂💕
